attackers_goals: Access data used by other pods that use the host's IPC namespace.
description: An identity created a Kubernetes pod with the host Inter Process Communications (IPC) namespace. This may indicate an adversary attempting to access data used by other pods that use the host's IPC namespace.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Inspect for any files in the /dev/shm shared memory location. Inspect for any IPC facilities being used with /usr/bin/ipcs.
